Hi Anna / Vanessa — attaching our first pass. Highlights:

- Column A: original question (from Medtrava template)
- Column B: Redwood short answer (compliant wording for DPA)
- Column C: jurisdictional note (EU/UK/HIPAA flags)
- Column D: evidence pointer (SOC 2 section, internal runbook link, or redwood public page)

Key flags we added:
1) Data residency: for EU clinical workloads, we recommend pinning to our EU-only Dedicated region (this requires a DPA amendment and a committed capacity clause).
2) Subprocessors: listed current subprocessors and noted any planned additions; we flagged that adding a non-EU subprocessor would trigger SCCs review.
3) Logging/KV cache: we annotated where prefix/KV caching may persist outside the EU for performance; proposed mitigation is per-customer configuration to disable cross-region caching and enable in-region cache nodes.

Attachments: RWI-DPIA-annotations-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

- Confirm whether EU-only Dedicated is acceptable for clinical ingestion.
- Confirm signature on Redwood Data Processing Annex if Dedicated is chosen.
